fact: The Minister of Justice said at a 20 May 2026 workshop that the Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS), launched 18 August 2025, is being rolled out and links the Judiciary, Ministry of Justice, Law Society, police, Anti-Corruption Commission and Correctional Services.

UNDP donated equipment worth USD 10,000 to the Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs in August 2025 to aid the rollout of the Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS), which aims to digitalise court operations and case tracking.

Swazi24 reports that on 22 May 2026 the Digital Eswatini Project team and the Ministry of Justice presented the Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS) and eCase workflows for criminal, land and civil cases to a parliamentary committee, with live demonstrations.
The Judiciary of Eswatini says it is implementing the Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS) across all courts.
The Judiciary of Eswatini says notable recent court decisions are published with links to full text on the Eswatini Legal Information Institute.
A UNDP Eswatini blog says that when its virtual remand work began in 2022 the judicial system was not digitised, with manual processes and traditional case management methods.
